summary: Frontend-only testing of the associations list/edit refactor on the Next.js Platform Admin dashboard (localhost:3002). Verified: (1) Super Admin login OK, (2) Pencil (Modifier) button now navigates to /platform/associations/[id] instead of toggling status, (3) Power/PowerOff button opens a proper confirmation modal before toggling, (4) edit page allows editing Nom + Libellé and saves via PUT, (5) admin list is shown with count, (6) new admin can be added via modal, (7) ASCB remained Active throughout. All 7 acceptance criteria from the review PASS. No functional regressions found. NOTE: Public URL https://mobile-bug-crush-1.preview.emergentagent.com serves the Expo mobile app; the Next.js dashboard is only reachable at http://localhost:3002 (as documented in iteration_7).

issues: Purple gradient bg-purple-600→purple-800 and purple icon square do NOT use Design System Navy (#1F4E79) / Gold (#F5A623). Same DS-drift observed in iteration_7 for /login but the /platform/login page appears to have been intentionally left purple — worth confirming with product whether Platform Admin should use a distinct color or match Kotiz DS.

Uses window.alert() for all success/error messages (update, add admin, reset password, delete admin). A toast/snackbar aligned with the DS would provide a smoother UX than blocking JS alerts. Non-blocker.
When Save is disabled (no dirty state), the button visually looks the same golden but reduced opacity (`disabled` state). OK, but there is no data-testid on the edit form controls.

action_items: OPTIONAL (UX): Replace window.alert() in /platform/associations/[id]/page.tsx with toast notifications for a smoother UX.
OPTIONAL (DS): Decide whether /platform/login should adopt the Kotiz Navy/Gold Design System like /login (currently purple).

OPTIONAL (testing): Add data-testid attributes on key controls in /platform/associations/page.tsx (pencil, toggle, delete) and /platform/associations/[id]/page.tsx (name-input, memberFieldLabel-input, save-button, add-admin-button, admin-row, admin-delete, admin-reset-password) to make future automated regression tests more robust. All current buttons were only findable via `title=...` attributes.
OPTIONAL (env visibility): iteration_7 items about /login (associations filter, Kotiz branding) still apply — outside this iteration's scope but not yet addressed.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/web/src/app/platform/associations/page.tsx: Correctly separates concerns — Pencil handler calls router.push, Power handler opens setToggleConfirm(assoc) modal. toggleMutation is only invoked via confirmToggle → good. The Trash still uses a native window.confirm() (line 166) which is inconsistent with the new Modal-based confirmation for toggle; recommend using the same DS Modal for delete confirmation.

/app/web/src/app/platform/associations/[id]/page.tsx: Good structure with separate mutations for update/addAdmin/resetPassword/deleteAdmin. Uses isDirty flag to gate the Save button — nice UX. Correctly guards against deleting the last admin (client-side check line 342). However all feedback is via window.alert() — 7 alerts in this single file — please migrate to a toast system.
Both files still import from 'lucide-react' rather than '@phosphor-icons/react' — inconsistent with dashboard/page.tsx which was migrated in iteration_7. Not a blocker but worth harmonizing.
The edit page assumes GET /platform/associations/:id returns memberFieldLabel and adminEmail/adminName — confirmed present in the API response. Good.
No data-testid attributes on any interactive element in these two files — reduces testability.

success_rate.frontend: 7/7 acceptance criteria PASS. 0 blockers, 3 minor UX/DS remarks.

rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: pencil button on associations list was silently toggling the association status (calling toggleMutation.mutate) instead of opening an edit form. Fix applied by main agent: (1) pencil onClick now routes to /platform/associations/[id] via router.push, (2) new Power/PowerOff icon button opens a confirmation Modal (setToggleConfirm state) before firing toggleMutation, (3) new /platform/associations/[id] page created with association-update form + admin management (list, add, reset password, delete). All acceptance criteria verified passing; ASCB was never deactivated in the process. The fix is complete and correct.
